tasks.title: Warehouse schema + write path + gold view
tasks.objective: Establish a warehouse write pool + ingestion repository (distinct from the read-only query port) and a reproducible warehouse:migrate; create the ingest_batch registry, sap_transaction, mis_budget, and the actual_by_key_month gold view.
acceptance_criteria: a reproducible warehouse:migrate creates ingest_batch, sap_transaction, mis_budget on the SEPARATE warehouse Postgres via a dedicated write pool/ingestion repository that does NOT alter the read-only Warehouse query port

ingest_batch enforces at most one active batch per (source_kind, period) with immutable batch metadata and an atomic candidate-load-then-switch; sap_transaction stores money as numeric(18,2) paise, carries a source-line unique identity (txn_no,line_id per batch) so duplicate input rows cannot double the gold total, and is indexed on (month,plant,cost_center,gl_code) and batch_id

tasks.reviewer_focus: Fresh WAREHOUSE ingest/DDL layer on the SEPARATE warehouse Postgres (config.ts warehouse{} from WAREHOUSE_PG_*; docker warehouse-db 127.0.0.1:5433, db 'warehouse'). Grounding: architecture 30-...:70-84, constitution/pnp-database-standards.md, decisions 0004 (no pre-join), 0014 (PoC no master), 0015 (warehouse snake_case deviation). NAMING: snake_case tables/columns + *_utc timestamps per decision 0015 (a warehouse-scoped deviation); the OTHER standard requirements STILL apply - audit columns, explicit FK indexes, numeric(18,2) money, constraints. BOUNDARY: do NOT modify the read-only query port (backend/src/warehouse/postgres.adapter.ts, warehouse.interface.ts) - they are NOT in write_scope; add a SEPARATE write pool + ingestion repository. MIGRATION: commit the generated warehouse migration SQL ONCE (drizzle-kit generate at authoring time via backend/drizzle-warehouse.config.ts); warehouse:migrate ONLY APPLIES the committed folder against the warehouse pool (a ts-node runner mirroring src/db/migrate.ts) - it never regenerates. Fail-fast if WAREHOUSE_PG_* is unset/misdirected so tables are never created in the wrong DB. BATCH GRAIN: one upload = ONE whole-file batch for a period (all plants); active key is (source_kind, period) - canonical_plant is a ROW attribute, NOT a batch key (client Q1: retain the full July batch). A re-upload atomically loads a candidate batch then flips is_active in one transaction; at most one active per (source_kind, period); source_kind is a check constraint; month is a stored 'YYYY-MM' (or first-of-month date) - state which. TABLES: ingest_batch(id, source_kind, period, uploaded_by TEXT [the app user id - NO cross-DB FK], uploaded_at_utc, row_count, validation_result, reconciliation_result, is_active); sap_transaction(batch_id FK+index, txn_no, line_id, posting_date, month, plant, plant_src, cost_center, gl_code, acct_name, contra_account, debit numeric(18,2), credit numeric(18,2), memo, reference, created_at_utc) with UNIQUE(batch_id, txn_no, line_id) and index (month,plant,cost_center,gl_code); mis_budget(batch_id FK+index, format_id, period, line_id, gl_code, cost_center, budget_amount numeric(18,2), rollover_amount numeric(18,2)) stored as-provided - define its grain explicitly. GOLD: actual_by_key_month is a PLAIN VIEW over the ACTIVE actuals batch, SUM(debit-credit) at paise grouped by (plant,cost_center,gl_code,month), with NAMED output columns (plant, cost_center, gl_code, month, actual_net). PROOF: hermetic warehouse-schema.test.ts asserts the schema module shape (tables, columns, numeric money, the at-most-one-active partial unique index, UNIQUE source-line identity, FK indexes, the view + its named columns) with NO DB; register it in test:hermetic + tools/quality-gate.test.mjs. The live warehouse:migrate + a FIXED seed fixture (a named script inserting specified rows into one active batch, with an expected actual_net) proving active-batch filtering + aggregation runs as DEMONSTRATED host evidence against docker warehouse-db (D-0008), recorded in tests.json - NOT 'insert two rows'. No semantic-domain registration (governed-joins).

review_budget.reason: Net-new warehouse ingest/DDL: a separate write pool + ingestion repository, a drizzle-warehouse config + committed migration + a warehouse:migrate apply-only runner for ingest_batch/sap_transaction/mis_budget, the actual_by_key_month view, a config fail-fast guard, a hermetic schema test + allow-list wiring, snake_case per 0015. No loader/API, no read-port changes.

tasks.title: SAP actuals Excel loader + idempotent per-period replace
tasks.objective: Add exceljs and POST /api/ingest/actuals to parse the SAP Base Report, net Debit-Credit at paise, apply DUB-NUR->DUB from the provided mapping workbook, retain raw + keys, and replace idempotently per period via a new active ingest_batch.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/ingest/actuals is guarded by AuthGuard + a new 'ingest' RBAC action grant and is added to the strict route allow-list, with a typed multipart DTO, Swagger success/error/auth docs, and CSRF/forbidden tests

the loader identifies the sheet by its required HEADER set (not file/sheet name), requires a single posting month, validates ALL rows before any write, and rejects invalid/mixed-period files with row-level diagnostics and NO change to the active batch

each row nets Actual = Debit - Credit at paise and applies the DUB-NUR->DUB normalization from the provided SAP Entries Mapping.xlsx; raw lines + original AND canonical keys are retained linked to a new ingest_batch
a re-upload of a period is idempotent: a new ingest_batch becomes active and the prior batch is retained (not erased), with no duplicate rows

tasks.reviewer_focus: SAP actuals Excel loader consuming the warehouse write path from warehouse-schema (REUSE IngestionRepository.replaceActualsBatch + createWarehouseWritePool + createWarehouseDb; do NOT re-implement the pool or the atomic candidate-load-then-flip, and do NOT modify the read-only postgres.adapter.ts / warehouse.interface.ts). Grounding: docs/context/2026-08-20-srihari-phase1-data/README.md (SAP Base Report = the 'SAP Report' sheet inside SAP Entries Mapping.xlsx; 4,113 July-2026 lines; header row = row 3 after two blank rows; raw nursery Plant is 'DUB-NUR', 88 lines, no 'DUB' in raw), the approved story plan's raw-retention criterion, decisions 0004/0013/0014/0015. RAW RETENTION (human-decided): add a NEW additive warehouse migration (backend/drizzle-warehouse/0001_*.sql, generate-once/apply-only via warehouse:migrate) + a 'raw' jsonb column on sap_transaction in warehouse-schema.ts, storing the FULL source row (incl. ShortName, both Comments, Origin, Loc.) so all source+drill fields are retained for later drill-down; update the hermetic warehouse-schema.test.ts assertion for the new column. This is the ONLY warehouse change; the read-only port stays untouched. SOURCE IDENTITY (human-decided): sap_transaction.line_id = the SAP Line_Id when present, else the SAP row number ('#' column) - 298 rows (incl. 6 nursery) have blank Line_Id but a unique '#'; this keeps line_id NOT NULL + UNIQUE(batch_id,txn_no,line_id) and lets the full July load succeed. ENDPOINT: new backend/src/ingest module (IngestModule in app.module.ts) POST /api/ingest/actuals guarded @UseGuards(AuthGuard)+@UseGuards(RequireAction('ingest')); ADD 'ingest' to GRANT_ACTIONS AND seed it to the admin role in db/migrate.ts baseRolePerms (existing roles admin/analyst/dba/manager) so the grant is obtainable after a normal migrate. multipart/form-data via FileInterceptor (field name 'file', exactly one .xlsx, a numeric byte cap and row cap, 413 on exceed); typed IngestActualsResponse in contract/src/api.ts returned RAW (match saved/pins - there is NO success-envelope wrapper here) with zod validation in ingest.schemas.ts; @ApiTags/@ApiOperation/@ApiConsumes('multipart/form-data')/@ApiBody/@ApiResponse for 201+400+401+403+413; structured logging (05/06); the global constitution-07 error envelope carries sanitized row-level diagnostics ({row, column, message}[]). ADD 'POST /api/ingest/actuals' to app.routes.test.ts allow-list. PARSER: identify the sheet by its REQUIRED HEADER SET (Transaction Number, Line_Id, Posting Date, Month, Plant, Cost Center, MIS GL Code, AcctName, Debit, Credit, ContraAct) not file/sheet name; tolerate blank lead rows + the duplicate 'Comments' header; PERIOD is the first-of-month derived from Posting Date (the 'Month' cell is only 'Jul' - display token, validate consistency but do NOT parse the period from it); require every row's period to match; VALIDATE ALL rows before ANY write. MONEY: Actual = Debit - Credit at PAISE as numeric(18,2) STRINGS (never float); exceljs number cells must be read without float drift. PLANTS: accept every nonblank source plant unchanged EXCEPT DUB-NUR -> DUB (a documented constant in plant-mapping.ts - the only nursery rule; NO catalogue/allow-list per 0014-no-master; the full Sheet1 mapping belongs to governed-joins, not here); keep plant (canonical) + plant_src (original). WRITER: replaceActualsBatch needs metadata{period, uploadedBy (the authenticated app-user id), validationResult (the row/period validation summary), reconciliationResult ({})}; own the pool lifecycle (createWarehouseWritePool -> createWarehouseDb -> IngestionRepository -> pool.end in finally). IDEMPOTENCY: a re-upload makes a NEW active ingest_batch, RETAINS the prior; 'no duplicate rows' means unique within a batch (UNIQUE(batch_id,txn_no,line_id) + whole-file-per-period grain) - across batches, rows intentionally repeat. PROOF: hermetic controller/parser/service tests use small FIXTURES (no DB, NOT the 639KB workbook - never bundle it); the live idempotent-replace + paise-net against docker warehouse-db is a WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1-gated test in ONE suite (name its file, suite, leaf, host command; per the warehouse-schema one-suite lesson) recorded as D-0008 demonstrated host evidence in tests.json.

review_budget.reason: Net-new ingest module (guarded multipart controller + service + header-identified parser + DUB-NUR mapping + zod/contract DTOs), the 'ingest' grant seeded in db/migrate, app.module + route allow-list wiring, exceljs dep + lockfile, a small additive raw-jsonb warehouse migration + schema edit, and hermetic controller/parser/service tests + a gated DB idempotency proof. Reuses the warehouse write path; no read-port change. Budget raised 1700->3000: the three-lens review APPROVED the finished diff (blocking=0, not overbuilt) - the parser hardening (jszip zip-bomb guard, raw-string comma-grouping, complete Month-token, mapped-column iteration), the additive raw jsonb column, and the comprehensive controller/parser/service + gated DB tests legitimately exceeded the estimate.
